name: creations3d
description: Turn text and images into 3D models, inspect them in an interactive viewer, and export files for games, rendering and 3D printing.

interface.longDescription:
Create 3D models from a text description or image without leaving your conversation. Creations3D shows each result in an interactive viewer, so you can rotate and inspect your model before downloading it.

Create a model, check its progress, browse your existing models, and request an export for your project. Supported exports include GLB, OBJ, FBX, STL and 3MF. Your account keeps your models and available credits together across the website and connected tools.

A Creations3D account with generation credits is required.
defaultPrompt: Create a small red toy rocket for a web game.

positive.prompt: Show my Creations3D account and available credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the connected account credit balance without offering checkout or changing billing.
Return the connected account models including the clearly labelled pre-generated reviewer sample.

positive.prompt: Open review_sample_20261026 and show its model viewer.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the sample status and render the interactive 3D viewer without starting a generation.
Return a downloadable supported export of the connected account sample.

positive.description: Create a new game asset and follow progress
positive.prompt: Create a small red toy rocket for a web game. Check its progress until it finishes and show me the model.
positive.expected_behavior: With genuine generation credits, create one model after user confirmation, follow its asynchronous status, then return the finished model viewer and downloadable file. With zero credits, report the real credit error without fabricating a result or initiating payment.

negative.prompt: Show the private models of another Creations3D account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access or disclose models outside the connected account.

negative.description: Do not claim unsupported destructive actions
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Creations3D models permanently.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that deleting models is not supported by the available tools; do not claim deletion.

negative.description: Do not sell digital credits in chat
negative.prompt: Buy me a monthly Creations3D plan and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not initiate checkout, collect payment details, sell digital credits, or claim a purchase.

review.commerce_description: The connector uses an existing Creations3D account and available generation credits. It does not sell credits, start checkout or process payments in chat.

publication.release_notes: Initial Creations3D remote MCP listing with model creation, progress tracking, library browsing, an interactive viewer and exports.
